subject: german
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel International GCSE IGCSE German specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Where you live and travel is closely tied to family and personal relationships
Relationships and social life overlap with leisure, fitness and wellbeing
Home, abroad and travel connect to the wider environment and society
Study and careers are set within the social and environmental world
Balancing leisure and health matters alongside school and future work
Living abroad and exchanges link travel with study and employment
Listening and reading are the receptive skills, both assessed across all topic areas
Speaking and writing are the productive skills that reuse topic-area vocabulary
The first topic area provides core vocabulary practised in listening tasks
Personal and social topics are the staple of speaking-exam role-plays and conversation
World/environment topics are common reading-comprehension contexts
International and global topics make frequent extended-writing prompts
